
From the Lojban web site FAQ (http://www.lojban.org/files/brochures/faq.htm):

'''cmavo''': a "little word" showing structure rather than carrying meaning

----

In fact, of course, most of them do carry meaning (I guess the [[elidable terminator|elidable terminator]]s don't; they are true structure words). Many carry meaning as their sole purpose; for example, numbers, ''[[jbocre: lerfu|lerfu]]'', and everything in ''[[jbocre: selma'o|selma'o]]'' UI. But it is true that the ''cmavo'' as a class determine the syntax of sentences. ''mi'e [[jbocre: jezrax|jezrax]]''
